strengths: independent of the exposed ASlib repository
public immutable Git objects are available
multiple classification datasets support dataset-level held-out evaluation

unresolved_before_freeze: bind the exact selected dataset objects or LFS object identifiers
review per-dataset rights and provenance; the repository-level MIT license alone is not final author/legal authority
predeclare the deterministic model portfolio and all randomness
define semantically defensible feature groups and acquisition charges without looking at outcomes
freeze dataset-level folds, balanced-error endpoint, proposal-order baselines, exact finite shield, and mutually exclusive terminals
add hostile synthetic controls, pinned requirements, and a freeze-only workflow that cannot retrieve datasets
